projects.title: WiFi Optimization with RL
projects.short_description: Team competition project: a reinforcement learning agent that tunes WiFi networks simulated in ns-3.
projects.description: Extended ns-3 with custom C++ modules that stream network metrics over Kafka to a PyTorch RL agent, which sends optimization commands back into the running simulation. Includes a visualization frontend.

projects.title: Quantum Safe DTLS 1.3
projects.short_description: Team competition project: post-quantum DTLS 1.3 on RISC-V IoT devices.
projects.description: Optimized post-quantum cryptography for DTLS 1.3 handshakes on RISC-V based IoT hardware, with simulation, benchmarking and a DTLS server setup.

projects.title: Distributed File System
projects.short_description: A GFS-inspired distributed file system with Raft replication.
projects.description: Built with Python asyncio and gRPC. It has a hierarchical namespace, a master node, per-block Raft replication across chunk servers and automatic failure detection.

projects.title: Contest Tracker
projects.short_description: A small site that tracks upcoming competitive programming contests.
projects.description: Scrapes Codeforces, CodeChef and AtCoder for upcoming contests, stores them in SQLite and serves them from a Flask single-page app.

projects.title: FShare
projects.short_description: Parallel file transfer that uses no temporary files.
projects.description: Streams files or whole directories over LAN or WAN with multiple parallel threads, IDM-style, without creating intermediate zip or temp files on either side. Supports optional compression and uses only the Python standard library.

projects.title: Gmail Declutterer
projects.short_description: Chrome extension to find and bulk delete emails from your biggest senders.
projects.description: Scans your Gmail inbox through the official Gmail API with OAuth, groups emails by sender, and lets you bulk-delete them.

projects.title: Resume Parser
projects.short_description: A simple project to parse resumes and extract information.
projects.description: A fun learning project to parse resumes and extract information and make it downloadable in excel format. Made using Flask.

projects.title: Food Delivery Service App
projects.short_description: A simple web app for food delivery service.
projects.description: A web app with customer, restaurant, delivery agent and admin interfaces. Made using MERN stack with JWT auth, Razorpay payments and TomTom maps.

projects.title: MyKhata App
projects.short_description: A web app to keep track of your day to day expenses.
projects.description: Track transactions by category with spend limits and a dashboard, record money lent to and borrowed from friends, and split expenses in groups that others can join by invite link or QR code. Installable as a PWA.

projects.title: NSSC Website
projects.short_description: Contributed to website for Space Fest, National Students' Space Challenge held at IIT Kharagpur.
projects.description: Contributed in making frontend for the website of National Students' Space Challenge held at IIT Kharagpur.

projects.title: spAts Website
projects.short_description: Contributed to website for Space Technology Students' Society, IIT Kharagpur.
projects.description: Contributed to make a React based website for Space Technology Students' Society, IIT Kharagpur.

projects.title: TicTacToe
projects.short_description: My first project in React. A simple TicTacToe game :)
projects.description: A simple TicTacToe game made using React. It was my first project in React and I learned a lot from it.

projects.title: GenWraps
projects.short_description: A simple method to wrap your python generators for replenishable iterators.
projects.description: This module provides simple classes to wrap your python generator code and produce multiple same state iterators. Used to avoid multiple generator calls.
